title: Daily briefing: The first new cat species described by science in a century
title_zh: 每日简报：百年首次被科学描述的新猫科物种
abstract: Leopardus tilcayo is smaller than a housecat and covered in leopard-like spots. Plus, the brain might spawn from two types of precursor cell and how to maintain the foundations of human flourishing in a climate crisis.
abstract_zh: Leopardus tilcayo 比家猫更小，身上布满类似豹纹的斑点。此外，脑部可能源自两种前体细胞，并讨论如何在气候危机中维护人类繁荣的基础。
